title: TypeSomething
description: White and warm paper-grey bands with warm-ink text, an acid-green brand colour and a blush-pink second voice. Montserrat throughout, light-weight big headings, 24px cards with hairlines, pill buttons.
notes: light is the faithful mode; dark is a sibling with an ink page and charcoal cards
Montserrat is the original's own (open) face
primary is a very light acid green: text on it is ink (primary-foreground), and primary as text only reads on dark or as a brand accent
